parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Set of weekly planning periods; the planning horizon length |T| is the number of weekly periods

parameters.name: tasks
parameters.description: Finite set of tasks, indexed by i

parameters.name: worker_types
parameters.description: Finite set of worker types, indexed by w

parameters.name: required_effective_work
parameters.description: Required effective work for each task i

parameters.name: methods
parameters.description: Feasible completion methods for each task i

parameters.name: worker_composition
parameters.description: Number of workers of type w required by one use of method m for task i

parameters.name: fixed_setup_cost
parameters.description: Fixed setup or coordination cost incurred if method m is selected for task i

parameters.name: weekly_wage
parameters.description: Weekly wage of each worker type w

parameters.name: weekly_capacity
parameters.description: Weekly effective-hour capacity of each worker type w

parameters.name: hiring_upper_bound
parameters.description: Maximum number of workers of each type w that may be hired

parameters.name: minimum_staffing
parameters.description: Minimum number of workers of type w that must be assigned if method m is selected for task i when specified in policy rules

parameters.name: skilled_share_limit
parameters.description: Maximum allowed fraction relating hired skilled workers to hired laborers

parameters.name: incompatible_method_pairs
parameters.description: Set of incompatible method pairs ((i,m),(j,n)) given in the policy rules

variables.name: method_selection
variables.description: Method-selection indicator for task i and method m

variables.name: hired_workers
variables.description: Number of hired workers of type w

variables.name: assigned_workers
variables.description: Number of workers of type w assigned to task i under method m

constraints.name: one_method_per_task
constraints.description: Each task must select exactly one feasible completion method.

constraints.name: worker_hiring_upper_bounds
constraints.description: The number of hired workers of each type cannot exceed the type-specific hiring upper bound.

constraints.name: method_composition_requirements
constraints.description: Assigned workers must match the required worker-type composition for each selected method.
constraints.formula: z_{i,m,w} = a_{i,m,w} x_{i,m} \qquad \forall i\in I,\ \forall m\in M_i,\ \forall w\in W

constraints.name: minimum_staffing_requirements
constraints.description: Designated task-method-worker triples must meet the specified minimum staffing levels when the corresponding method is selected.

constraints.name: incompatible_method_pairs
constraints.description: Incompatible method pairs listed in policy rules cannot both be selected.
constraints.formula: incompatible pairs in P cannot be jointly active

constraints.name: skilled_share_limit
constraints.description: The number of hired skilled workers cannot exceed the allowed fraction of hired laborers.

constraints.name: task_work_requirement
constraints.description: Each task's required effective work must be met by the selected method’s assigned staff within the weekly horizon.
constraints.formula: \sum_{m\in M_i}\sum_{w\in W} a_{i,m,w} h_w z_{i,m,w} \geq H_i \qquad \forall i\in I

objectives.name: total_weekly_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total weekly cost, including wage payments for hired workers and fixed setup costs for selected methods.

final_objective.description: Minimize the total weekly cost, consisting of wage payments for all hired workers and fixed setup costs for selected task methods.
final_objective.formula: Z^* = \sum_{w\in W} c_w y_w + \sum_{i\in I} \sum_{m\in M_i} F_{i,m} x_{i,m}
